display_long_description:
Candyscapes – VR Match 3 Puzzles is a thoughtfully designed virtual reality puzzle game made specifically for Meta Quest. Instead of traditional screen-based play, Candyscapes lets you use Touch Controllers to swipe and match candies directly in VR, creating a more natural and engaging way to play a classic match-3 experience.

Each level is carefully crafted with clear goals, balanced difficulty, and smooth progression. Players can plan moves strategically, activate powerful boosters, and clear challenging boards through precise controller interactions. The gameplay is designed to feel comfortable and intuitive, making it suitable for both casual players and puzzle enthusiasts.

The game focuses on relaxed immersion rather than fast reflexes. Bright visuals, responsive controls, and VR-friendly interactions ensure a smooth experience that respects Meta Quest comfort guidelines. There is no hand tracking all interactions are intentionally built around Touch Controllers for accuracy and consistency.

Candyscapes brings classic match-3 gameplay into VR with a polished, immersive approach, creating a comfortable and engaging experience players can enjoy again and again.
